author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: low convertible in side view with an open top, a round headrest bump at the rear, a raked windshield and two wheels whose upper halves form the body's wheel arches. A first candidate with r5 wheels looked right but failed internal spacing (tail, nose and hood under 4 ink from the arches), so the wheels became r4 with 8-unit overhangs. The rejected drawing was a tall boxy body with a triangle windshield and heavy wheels.
omissions: The windshield is a single raked stroke rather than a framed pane; wheels are smaller than in the reference to keep 8-unit overhangs.
drawing_plan: HRECT_M: body contour tail x=4, deck y=19 with r4 headrest bump (8..16), cubic hood to nose x=44, sill y=34 with r4 arches at x=16/32; wheels closed by lower arcs; windshield (26,19)-(21,10).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'car': body outline sharing the wheel arcs, wheels as circles.
